decisive_items: a well-circumscribed 5 cm lesion in the left retroperitoneal space, adjacent to the iliopsoas muscle
low signal intensity on T1-weighted images and high signal intensity on T2-weighted images
response.rationale: The psoas-adjacent location, well-circumscribed borders, low T1/high T2 signal, and heterogeneous enhancement in a young patient favor a neurogenic tumor (e.g., schwannoma); retroperitoneal sarcoma is the main differential but is less specifically supported by these features.

rejected.why: Too broad; lacks the nerve-associated location and signal pattern.
No fat signal or liposarcoma-specific features; low T1 argues against a fat-containing tumor.
Only heterogeneous enhancement is cited; no distinctive solitary fibrous tumor features.
Lymphoma is usually more homogeneous and less well-circumscribed; no systemic or nodal clues.
Retroperitoneal location alone is insufficient; lymphoma features are not otherwise supported.
